inspiration.observed_pattern: A SQL workload deduplicates symbols from a quote table into a directory and separately returns top symbols through grouped ordering with LIMIT.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one duplicate label and one lower-ranked label. INSERT ... SELECT DISTINCT with deterministic ordering and LIMIT 1 loads only the highest distinct label.

fixture_notes: NOVA appears twice and ORBIT once; LIMIT 1 loads NOVA once and leaves ORBIT out.
determinism_notes: Quote value descending plus symbol ascending defines the selected distinct row. All source values are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE market_quotes_min (symbol VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, quote_value INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE featured_symbols_min (symbol VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, quote_value INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO featured_symbols_min (symbol, quote_value) SELECT DISTINCT symbol, quote_value FROM market_quotes_min ORDER BY quote_value DESC, symbol LIMIT 1

checks.sql: SELECT symbol, quote_value FROM featured_symbols_min ORDER BY symbol
SELECT symbol, quote_value FROM market_quotes_min ORDER BY symbol, quote_value
